name: Micron Singapore HBM advanced packaging facility

parties.name: Singapore Economic Development Board
parties.note: Government partner represented at the groundbreaking.

summary: A high-bandwidth memory packaging plant next to Micron's existing Singapore operations, which Micron and Singapore's Economic Development Board present as the country's first HBM packaging facility. Micron broke ground in January 2025. The original plan called for operations to begin in 2026; Micron's latest filing expects the facility to expand its advanced packaging capacity from early calendar 2027.

location.note: Adjacent to Micron's existing Singapore facilities; Micron's January 2026 NAND fab release places it in the same manufacturing complex as that fab.

metrics.note: Stated as US$7 billion (SG$9.5 billion), spent through the end of the decade and beyond.
Estimated staffing after future site expansion.

milestones.note: Operations were scheduled to begin in 2026.
Meaningful expansion of advanced packaging capacity expected from early calendar 2027.
